messages:
ana (Finance): Flagging a post-close issue: invoice ACME-APR-2026 omitted a partner rebate line of $3,950. Posted April results show revenue overstated. Uploaded source invoice + rebate contract to s3: s3://redwood-bills/acme/ACME-APR-2026.pdf :warning:

ben (Billing): Can you paste the invoice excerpt? Need to see if this was filtered or never populated.

ana (Finance): Excerpt copied from PDF: ```
Service: Dedicated reserved pool (Apr 1-30) | Amount: $4,500.00
Partner rebate (per contract) | Amount: -$3,950.00 | MISSING ON PDF
Net due: $550.00
```

owen (FP&A): $3.95k is below our $5k restatement threshold but after close. Recommend prior-period adjusting JE and issue credit memo. Also suggests a temporary $5k bump to our unbilled accrual for May given potential similar misses.

ben (Billing): Looks like the invoice renderer collapsed negative passthrough lines that matched rebate codes. I'll open ticket.

billing-bot (billing-bot): Created ticket BILL-9123  invoice renderer removed negative passthrough line. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9123

claire (Controller): For <$5k we can do a prior-period adjustment. Ana, propose JE mapping and include the rebate contract + ticket in supporting docs when you post.

ana (Finance): Proposed JE (to post in April): debit 4002 Dedicated Revenue $3,950.00; credit 2105 Customer Credits $3,950.00. JE memo: "partner rebate omission - ACME-APR-2026". Target posting: EOD tomorrow. Will attach docs and ticket link.

ben (Billing): I'll issue credit memo CM-2026-021 and regenerate invoice PDF. Adding a note in billing run: "BILL-9123 - passthrough negative line filtering".

owen (FP&A): Please also add a one-line footnote in the month-close pack about the JE and the potential systemic cause. I'll adjust accruals as proposed.

claire (Controller): Approve JE mapping. Sign-off contingent on attachments + ticket. If we see >2 customers affected this month escalate to a deployment hold for renderer.

ana (Finance): Thanks all  will post JE request in NetSuite and ping for sign-off. Closing guidance: monitor BILL-9123 for scope and report counts daily.
